verdict.rationale: Klaviyo supports event-triggered flows/automations (klaviyo-docs-17, klaviyo-docs-19, klaviyo-docs-35) and webhooks (klaviyo-docs-31) that let users define rules triggering actions on events, which is the core automation-depth capability. However, evidence is thin on AI-native rule authoring specifically (e.g., natural-language rule definition, agent-driven trigger configuration) beyond MCP-assisted campaign creation. missing for 10: documentation of AI-native/agentic authoring of trigger rules (vs. UI-based flow builder), independent hands-on verification of automation reliability, and detail on rule complexity/conditions supported via API or MCP.
